# Best 65W GaN charger for a laptop and phone

**Top pick: Anker 735 Charger (Nano II 65W), $29.99 at Newegg**
[Buy at Newegg](https://www.newegg.com/p/359-00D8-002C3)

- It has two USB-C ports and one USB-A port, and either USB-C port delivers the full 65W to a single device.
- With a laptop and a phone connected, Anker's spec is 45W + 20W across the two USB-C ports. That's enough for a MacBook Air or Dell XPS 13-class laptop plus a fast-charging phone.
- It supports PPS, per Anker's [spec sheet](https://service.anker.com/product-description/a085g000004x2BVAAY). One review I found says it lacks PPS, but I'd trust the manufacturer's listing. If you have a Samsung Galaxy, the Baseus below is the safer choice.
- It has foldable prongs and is about the size of an AirPods Pro case. Anker gives an 18-month warranty, and Newegg offers 30-day returns.
- It's an Anker-store listing, and [Laptopbee](https://www.laptopbee.com/best-65w-usb-c-chargers/) picks the Anker 65W 3-port as its overall favorite.

**Other good options**

- **UGREEN Nexode Pro 65W** is [Smart Gadget Kit's](https://smartgadgetkit.com/best-gan-charger/) best overall pick.
  - It has a verified 65W from one port, three ports in total, and a 113g body.
  - It comes with US, UK and EU plug heads, which makes it good for travel.
  - It splits 45W + 20W with two devices, and the USB-A port tops out at 22.5W.
  - I didn't get a price for it, so check the "Check latest price" buttons on that page.
- **Baseus Enercore 67W (CJ11), about $29.99** is the best midrange pick in [Tom's Hardware's tested roundup](https://www.tomshardware.com/peripherals/usb/best-usb-chargers).
  - It held full wattage throughout testing and ran the coolest of the group.
  - It has a built-in retractable USB-C cable plus two more USB-C ports, so you don't need to carry a separate cable.
  - The roundup has Amazon and Best Buy links.
- **Baseus GaN5 Pro 65W 2-pack, $49.99** is a good buy if you want one charger for home and one for your bag, or if you own a Samsung Galaxy. It supports PPS, and [Dealectric lists it](https://dealectric.com/baseus-gan5-pro-65w-2c-u) with a [buy link to Baseus's US store](https://dealectric.com/go/baseus-gan5-pro-65w-2c-u). That link is an affiliate link, so Dealectric earns a commission if you buy through it. With two or three devices connected, the laptop port drops to 45W.

**What to expect from any 65W charger**

- The 65W is shared. Charging a laptop and a phone together drops the laptop port to about 45W. That's fine for ultrabooks and MacBook Airs, but a power-hungry 65W laptop will charge more slowly.
- Put the laptop in the main port (USB-C 1) and the phone in the second.
- Cables usually aren't included, so you may need to buy a good USB-C cable.

If your laptop is a 14" or 16" MacBook Pro or a gaming laptop, 65W is too little. Look at a 100W charger instead, such as the Anker Prime 100W that Smart Gadget Kit recommends.
